title: BlueAxolotl
description: A high performance, Lunar/Feather-inspired client experience. Boost your FPS with fabric optimizations while enjoying built-in cosmetics, utility mods, and a sleek, modern UI. This is BlueAxolotl, the modern client.

A high performance, Lunar/Feather-inspired client experience. Free (As in both Libre and Money) Cosmatics, Client features (fullbright, zoom, low fire, etc...) and of course, a big focus on optimization! 

Here are the basics!
